table_links_rule: Each key must exist in legacy_tables. capability_ids resolve to exact planned_test and oracle; constraint_ids resolve to target_constraints.

target_constraints.rule: Unique digest; redemption count/capacity checked under row lock; revoked/expired invitations cannot redeem.
Append-only trigger; unique version/hash; partial unique index for active=true; Draft 2020-12 schemas preserved and executed by jsonschema.
CHECK origin/author/reviewer/approval combinations, positive slots/reward and valid state/deadline combinations.
Unique task/slot/generation and one active occupant; result/cancellation histories are append-only prefixes enforced by trigger.
Append-only trigger; unique business key; valid delta/source/reversal CHECKs; one terminal settlement per assignment slot.
Unique kind/subject/revision; pair advisory lock makes max revision the single current karma vote; correction predecessor must have lower revision.
Append-only case history; unique appeal per parent; partial unique open alert on normalized pair/episode; private payload never selected by member queries.
Append-only trigger; unique namespace/actor/key; exact command fingerprint; complete actor/action/entity/outcome for mutations and sensitive reads.
Unique dedupe key; lease owner/version compare-and-set; bounded attempts and scheduled retry; terminal events immutable.
UTC-aware timestamps, foreign keys for query-critical relations and discriminator/payload_version CHECKs for every typed JSON payload.

Durable draft owner/subject/revision/status/confirmed_target are ordinary constrained columns; expected revision uses locked compare-and-swap; unique confirmed target makes confirm exact; restart reads the same draft.

capabilities.rule: Telegram initData, server session, exact Origin, revoke and no secret logging protect Mini App.
capabilities.oracle: Invalid/stale/replayed auth and wrong Origin have zero effects; revoke blocks immediately; logs contain no raw proof.

capabilities.rule: Hashed expiring revocable invitation creates pending application; approve/reject/resubmit and exactly one starting grant are atomic.
capabilities.oracle: One concurrent redemption/decision wins; state, grant, audit and outbox commit together or not at all.

capabilities.rule: Profile, timezone, visibility, roles, permissions, superadministrator boundary and seven account statuses remain authoritative.
capabilities.oracle: Every allowed actor/state succeeds and every unlisted combination has zero effects; temporary sanctions expire on read.

capabilities.rule: Categories/templates are versioned/admin-managed; free-form creation remains; historical Draft 2020-12 input/result validation and task snapshots remain exact.
capabilities.oracle: Old/new validator accept and reject the same positive/negative corpus for every stored schema; activation race has one winner; snapshot hash is exact.

capabilities.rule: Free/template member task validates size/reward/content/deadline and reserves every slot atomically.
capabilities.oracle: Valid publish creates exact reserve per slot; invalid/fault/replay creates no partial or duplicate effect.

capabilities.rule: Multi-slot task closes intake, preserves active performers, coordinates cancellation responses and refunds only free/cancelled slots.
capabilities.oracle: Slot/assignment rights and per-slot ledger totals match legacy outcomes for every cancellation response matrix.

capabilities.rule: Community publication approval, independent reviewer/conflict rules, multi-slot execution and issued reward remain.
capabilities.oracle: Only authorized publication/review succeeds; performer/reviewer conflicts are denied; no member reserve exists; exact issued reward/experience settles.

capabilities.rule: Accept/withdraw/replacement, active limits, result versions, full/partial/reject/revision and private dispute handoff remain.
capabilities.oracle: Last-slot and approve/cancel races have one winner; history is immutable; one origin-correct settlement and handoff result.

capabilities.rule: Task/review/dispute deadlines, reminders, expiry, no-show and finalizers are restart-safe and idempotent.
capabilities.oracle: Fixed-clock legacy/new state, ledger, reliability and dedupe outcomes match after retry and restart.

capabilities.rule: Append-only credit/experience ledger covers grants, reserve, earn, refund, partial/community reward, penalty, adjustment and fraud reversal without overdraw/lost update.
capabilities.oracle: Per-member/aggregate credit and experience equal ledger; duplicate/conflict/fault/race produces exact legacy outcome and no partial effect.

capabilities.rule: Admin correction, fraud and appeal reversals are authorized, exact, linked, idempotent and fail wholly if balance/experience cannot reverse.
capabilities.oracle: Every source delta has at most one exact reversal; insufficient reversible balance leaves case, ledger, audit and outbox unchanged.

capabilities.rule: Experience-derived levels and leaderboard use authoritative ledger and one active immutable config version.
capabilities.oracle: Every member total/level/rank matches baseline before and after config activation/backfill.

capabilities.rule: Paid-pair eligibility persists; active peers create/change +1/0/-1; aggregate is anonymous; raw author/comment/history requires karma_review and audited read; revision exclusion/restoration is exact.
capabilities.oracle: Vote/history/aggregate match baseline; unauthorized raw read returns nothing; each authorized read audits; exclusion never auto-sanctions.

capabilities.rule: Terminal assignment outcomes, exact partial weight, no-show, member/community statistics and append-only corrections remain.
capabilities.oracle: Ordered event/correction chains and every aggregate/statistic equal baseline at fixed clock.

capabilities.rule: Reserve freezes; evidence/result history is immutable; origin-specific seven-outcome resolution writes ledger/reliability/audit atomically.
capabilities.oracle: Every allowed/forbidden outcome and all side effects match baseline; fault/race leaves exactly one complete resolution or none.

capabilities.rule: One appeal in seven days is decided by another conflict-free admin and exact-reverses prior effects before new outcome while paid slot stays occupied.
capabilities.oracle: One appeal exists; unauthorized/late/insufficient reversal has zero effects; successful chain and occupied slot match baseline.

capabilities.rule: Notice/warning/restriction/suspension/ban are role/action scoped, timed, reversible and historical; effective status expires without worker delay.
capabilities.oracle: Every role/action/status/time combination matches baseline; event history remains immutable and visible only to authorized admin.

capabilities.rule: Risk signals are review-only; fourth paid pair interaction opens one private non-blocking episode; authorized outcome may impose bounded idempotent penalties.
capabilities.oracle: Threshold/episode/count match baseline; signal alone never blocks/pays/punishes; private notes never reach logs/member API/notification.

capabilities.rule: Case party/conflicted moderator/community performer/reviewer cannot decide own outcome; replacement reviewer resumes reviewer_required.
capabilities.oracle: All conflict combinations deny with zero effects; valid replacement generation restores review and preserves history.

capabilities.rule: Significant events create privacy-minimal deduplicated notifications; concurrent lease, retry, poison event and obsolete action remain safe.
capabilities.oracle: One delivery outcome per dedupe key; stale completion rejected; poison bounded; neighboring event proceeds; payload contains no private field.

capabilities.rule: Mutations and sensitive reads have immutable complete audit; exact replay returns stored outcome and conflicting replay has zero effects across restart.
capabilities.oracle: State/ledger/audit/outbox commit atomically; replay/restart returns identical outcome; conflict/fault adds nothing.

capabilities.rule: A task creation preview is durable across restart, owner-only, revision-checked, replay-safe and exact-confirmed into at most one published task.
capabilities.oracle: Restart returns identical owner/payload/revision; foreign/stale/cancelled confirm has zero effects; concurrent/exact replay publishes one task and one reserve set.

capabilities.rule: An assignment result preview is durable across restart, performer-owned, revision-checked, replay-safe and exact-confirmed into at most one immutable result version.
capabilities.oracle: Restart returns identical performer/payload/revision; foreign/stale confirm has zero effects; concurrent/exact replay creates one result revision and records one confirmed target.

capabilities.rule: A moderation resolution preview is durable across restart, authorized-owner-only, case-revision-checked, replay-safe and exact-confirmed into at most one resolution.
capabilities.oracle: Restart returns identical actor/case/code/reason/revision; foreign/stale confirm has zero effects; concurrent/exact replay applies one resolution with one complete ledger/reliability/audit/outbox effect set.

capabilities.rule: All functional data and invariants move to a separate compact database while source stays unchanged and backup restores.
capabilities.oracle: All 43 legacy tables classified; functional counts/checksums/states/chains match; source bytes/head unchanged; rerun is deterministic.

capabilities.rule: Every retained member/admin capability is reachable in Mini App; only old Telegram menu/callback/FSM transport disappears.
capabilities.oracle: Route inventory covers every capability ID; keyboard/accessibility smoke passes; no aiogram callback/FSM entrypoint remains.
